STATE OF UTAH
DEPARTMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES
STATE CAPITOL BUILDING / SALT LAKE CITY, UTAH 84114
225
GOVERNOR
August 2, 1972
GORDON E HARMSTON EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR
Mr. James Watt, Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Watt:
Re: K 14
As a follow-up to my letter dated July 14, 1972, the enclosed memorandum represents additional comments from an in-depth study of the draft environmental statement concerning use of off-road vehicles on the public lands by the Department's Environmental Impact Evaluation Committee. They reflect the big concern user groups in Utah have because of the preponderance of federally owned land.
Thank you for the opportunity to comment.
Sincerely,
Gordon E. Harmston
Executive Director
